comment: The signal jacks and the outputs carry whatever is sampled, so no family is set for them. The third section reads A2_PARAM, B2_PARAM, C2_PARAM, D2_PARAM and QU2_PARAM, which are the middle section's controls. The probability test sits inside the `if (!CVcon)` branch only, so it gates generated voltages and not sampled ones; the README says it decides whether an incoming trigger is used at all. The quantise block runs after both branches and so applies to sampled values too, against the README. Per-channel SchmittTrigger arrays are declared and never used; the source carries the comment "NEEDS REPAIR!! Want it to be GTin polyphonic not VoltageSum".
